name: Matou Zouken
source:
Zouken is a shrewd, powerful, but ancient sorcerer who is patriarch of the Matou family and is known to be the grandfather of Shinji and Sakura.

He has amassed a large and extensive library of sorcerous knowledge, yet his lessons are strict and harsh. Zouken considers [url=/c41]Shinji[/url] to be a disgrace of a sorcerer, and believes [url=/c35]Sakura[/url] may have more potential than her brother. 

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Fate/stay_night_characters]Wikipedia[/url]]
